250-779-1315-1479-8337.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-8337.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1315-1479-8337.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

2317-2511-7084-8345.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
728-6972-8329--225.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.
728-6972-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

141-413-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-413-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

654-813-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-813-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Scholar of the Ages and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Scholar of the Ages and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-813-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Scholar of the Ages and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

5319-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
5319-6495-6972.notes: If Geralf's Messenger starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

728-2866-4708-4986.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

586-864-997-3125-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-997-3125-7422.description:
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Garrison Excavator.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

765-1669-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Guildless Commons.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Guildless Commons from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Repeat.

862-1003-1591-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-1003-1591-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

546-1409-4613-7728.notablePrerequisites: There are at least five creature cards in your graveyard.
546-1409-4613-7728.description:
Activate Voracious Brood by paying {2}, blinking it. Voracious Brood enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
When Voracious Brood enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Voracious Brood.
Activate Voracious Brood using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

821-2523-2869.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Mogg Fanatic that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Repeat using the Mogg Fanatic token

3682-4518-5542-7646.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Kor Skyfisher from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3259-6791-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6791-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6791-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

147-5147-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5147-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5147-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

3490-4050-6720-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6720-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

856-5256-5776-6351.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3835-5078-6918.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

997-1636-4023-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
997-1636-4023-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-3291-5056.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least three.
1978-3291-5056.description:
Cause Karametra's Acolyte to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat from step 2.

1640-3214.description:
Activate Firedrinker Satyr by paying {1}{R}, attempting to deal 1 damage to you, but dealing 1 damage to Firedrinker Satyr instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Firedrinker Satyr triggers, attempting to deal 1 damage to you, but dealing 1 damage to Firedrinker Satyr instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat step 2 in an infinite loop, which causes the game to end in a draw.

3476-4315-4679-6053.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of Airtight Alibi attached to Yenna, and then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
When the Airtight Alibi token enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Yenna by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the Airtight Alibi trigger, untapping Yenna.
Activate Phantatog by sacrificing the Airtight Alibi token.
Repeat.

2232-2665-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-2665-6749.description:
Cast Progenitor Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Progenitor Mimic enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Progenitor Mimic from the battlefield to your hand.
When Progenitor Mimic leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Progenitor Mimic from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

700-3769-3862.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has two or more cards in hand.
700-3769-3862.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal nonlethal damage to Body of Knowledge after it is donated to an opponent.
700-3769-3862.description:
Donate Body of Knowledge to an opponent that has two or more cards in hand, then deal nonlethal damage to it.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing its controller to draw that many cards.
Orcish Bowmaster triggers for each card drawn. Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Body of Knowledge and causing you to amass Orcs 1.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-4636-5770-6753.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating four 6/6 Beast artifact creature tokens.
When the Beasts enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers four times, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

1526-4067-5672.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
1526-4067-5672.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures.
1526-4067-5672.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

643-1571-1827-5728.notablePrerequisites:
Aspiring Champion does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Your life total is at least 3.
643-1571-1827-5728.description:
Cast Vampiric Tutor by paying {B}, searching your library for Blightsteel Colossus and putting it on top of your library, then causing you to lose 2 life.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aspiring Champion.
Aspiring Champion triggers, causing you to sacrifice it, then reveal Blightsteel Colossus from the top of your library and put it onto the battlefield as a Demon due to Maskwood Nexus, then causing Blightsteel Colossus to give each opponent eleven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

208-1017-1656-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
208-1017-1656-4762.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Thought Courier's ability by tapping it, causing you to loot.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1495-2744-3062-3828.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1495-2744-3062-3828.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Druid's Call triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Repeat.
During the next player's turn, you may remove all of the +1/+1 counters from Triskelion to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2136-2972-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Orthion.
2136-2972-5200.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Ganax with haste.
Put all Ganax tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Ganax triggers five times.
Resolve all Ganax triggers, creating 30 Treasure tokens.
Activate twelve Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {9}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other creature using Orthion's ability.

2390-3372-4179.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a counter on a permanent or player.
2390-3372-4179.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing All Will Be One to become an enchantment creature until end of turn.
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control +1/+1 and infect until end of turn.
Put a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, giving an opponent a poison counter and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat step 4.

600-3334-4450.description:
Cast Jace by paying {1}{U}{U}.
Jace enters the battlefield with four loyalty counters due to Lae'zel.
Activate Jace's third loyalty ability by removing four loyalty counters from it.
Jace dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Jace ability, creating two non-legendary copies of Jace, which enter with four loyalty counters each due to Lae'zel.
Repeat from step 3 using a Jace token.
Once you have infinite Jace tokens, you may activate their second loyalty abilities by removing two loyalty counters from them, creating infinite 2/2 Illusion creature tokens.

4191-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion without paying its mana cost due to Aluren.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-3257-3703.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3257-3703.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Sporemound, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Sporemound trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
